translations.text: In this you will rejoice, though now, for a little while, as circumstances require, you have been grieved by various trials.
And if you call him Father who judges impartially according to each person's deeds, then spend the time of your stay here as foreigners in fear.
And the word of the Lord remains forever. This is the word that was proclaimed to you as good news.
Like newborn infants, long for the pure, spiritual milk, so that through it you may grow toward salvation.
And you, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual temple, to be an undefiled priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.
For whoever wishes to love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.
Let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it.
For the eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous, and his ears attend to their prayers, but the face of the Lord is against evildoers.
Maintain a gentle disposition, so that when they speak evil of you, those who slander your good conduct in Christ may be put to shame.
Since Christ suffered in the flesh for us, arm yourselves also with the same resolve, for whoever suffers in the flesh ceases from sin.
